title: Welcome Orbit — 72hr concierge & admin delegation
body:
Purpose: a tight, replicable 72-hour concierge runbook to reduce friction for new hires, shift administrative load off hiring managers in the first 3 days, and create a predictable ‘first impressions’ flow. This is intentionally lightweight — treat as a 0–72 baseline that can be extended by team-specific add-ons.

What this doc contains:
- Preboarding micro-plan (before day 0)
- Hour-by-hour / day-by-day 0–72 sample schedule (concierge-owned vs manager-owned tasks)
- Admin delegation checklist (IT, access, compliance, perks)
- Manager and buddy phone/email scripts (short)
- Quick interview rubric reference for hiring follow-ups
- Notes-to-self and open questions (experimental bits we want to A/B)

Quick preboarding (owner = people-ops concierge, typical timeline: offer accepted -> 48 hours):
- Send a single "Welcome Orbit" email with: start date/time, first-day agenda, Slack intro, parking/entry instructions, remote setup expectations, people-ops concierge contact (Riley).
- Trigger IT ticket: laptop model, courier date, VPN instructions, MFA enrollment request. (people-ops concierge creates JIRA-IT request template).
- HR forms link + deadline: W-4/equiv, direct deposit, KYC doc upload (one link, single click).
- Manager: prepare first-week project stub and 30/60/90 expectations doc (one page).
- Buddy: assigned and intro DM in Slack.

72-hour baseline (who owns what):
Day 0 (first day) — morning:
- Concierge: 30 min welcome call (15 min logistics + 15 min culture Q&A).
- IT: verify laptop received and user can login; if remote, confirm camera + mic working.
- Manager: 20 min 1:1 (welcome, role context, immediate 3 tasks). Keep it lightweight — no performance talk.
- Buddy: 45 min walkthrough of team Slack channels, code repo quickstart, and working norms.

Day 0 — afternoon:
- Concierge: onboarding pulse check (Slack ping "everything ok? any blockers?").
- Manager: introduce to immediate cross-functional partners (short async intros if needed).
- People-ops: complete benefits enrollment hand-holding if new hire needs help.

Day 1 — check-in cadence:
- Concierge: 10am pulse check and 3pm wrap.
- Manager: deep-dive 45–60 min role onboarding (systems, where to find docs, first ticket).
- Buddy: pair on the first practical task for 2 hours (shadow + short debrief).

Day 2 — stabilization:
- Manager: 30 min expectations + calendar recurring 1:1 setup.
- Concierge: confirm all access escalations resolved (CI/CD, model-serving dashboards, internal registries).
- Buddy: hand off useful short-cuts & checklist of things you wished you knew.

Admin delegation checklist (concierge creates/owns tickets; manager remains accountable for people decisions):
- Access & security:
  - Create SSO account + group memberships (engineering, infra, model-serving).
  - Request service account access: read/dev vs prod-ops — escalate if prod needed immediately.
  - MFA & security training enrollment (people-ops confirms completion in 7 days).
- Tools & infra:
  - GitHub org invite + repo permissions.
  - CI build agent access + token provisioning (if role requires).
  - Cloud console & billing read-only (unless manager requests more).
- Productivity apps:
  - Slack workspace invite, add to team channels, create pinned "starter" doc for their role.
  - Calendar: add recurring standups, team 1:1 and all-hands.
- Compliance:
  - NDA + data handling pointer doc (concise bullet list), copy to hire file.
  - If working on Private deployments: ensure VPN onboarding + KMS/HSM request queued.
- Practical logistics:
  - Desk/parking pass (onsite) or shipping confirmation (remote).
  - Swag + welcome card (concierge coordinates).

Manager script (5 min, day 0):
- Opening: "Welcome — quick context: why this role matters right now and the team’s top priority this quarter."
- Short specifics: "First week, please focus on X (orientation), Y (first ticket), Z (meetings to schedule).",
- Safety net: "If anything is blocked, ping me and the concierge — we’ll triage within the day."
- Close: "We’ll meet regularly — our 1:1 is on your calendar; if you want to move it, let me know."

Buddy rapid script (intro DM / 5–10 min):
- DM: "Hi — I’m your buddy, congrats! Quick plan: I’ll pair with you on day 1 for two hours, show you the repos and CLI cheats, and be your first ask for small logistics. Slack me anytime."

Compact hiring-run follow-up rubric (for managers who want to re-check interview signals during early ramp):
- Purpose: surface any mis-hire signals early without biasing ramp behavior. Use as observational checklist (not a formal performance review).
- Time windows: quick check at day 7 and day 30.
- Signals and interpretation (score 1–3; 1 = red, 2 = caution, 3 = green):
  - Role comprehension: understands team goals and immediate tasks (probe: "explain first task in your words").
  - Communication clarity: asks clarifying Qs, responds to feedback.
  - Delivery orientation: shows capacity to complete tiny end-to-end task in the first week.
  - Collaboration: integrates with buddy and cross-functional partners.
  - Security posture: follows baseline security onboarding and data rules.
- Red flags (any 1s on two consecutive checks -> manager escalation):
  - repeated missed deadlines without clear blockers logged,
  - inability to access required systems beyond expected IT lag,
  - consistent unclear communication that blocks other team members.

Notes-to-self / experimental items (open):
- Try a 20-minute "concierge office hours" block daily for the first week vs 1:1 concierge calls — test for scale.
- Automate the Slack starter doc creation by role via a small infra job (saves repeated edits).
- Measure NPS from hires at day 7 and day 30; aim for >8 day 7.
- Investigate making the first task always public/non-sensitive to reduce access escalations.

Appendix: quick templates
- Welcome Orbit email subject: "Welcome to Redwood — start date confirmation + 1st day details"
- Short welcome email body: 3 bullets: logistics, first morning meet, who to DM for problems.
- People-ops concierge intro template: provides direct Slack link and 2 windows of 30-min availability on the hire’s first day.

Unresolved questions:
- Should we require managers to schedule a 30-min hiring follow-up at offer acceptance? (pro: accountability; con: calendar friction)
- Do we route all VPN/KMS access requests through people-ops for privileged roles? (operational overhead vs safety)

TODOs before this doc becomes final:
- Collect manager feedback from 3 beta hires (Marco will coordinate).
- Add a one-click IT ticket template to JIRA (Ayesha owns).
- Draft a 7-day NPS form and set up automated reminders (Lina owns).

Bottom line: a tight concierge baseline reduces day-0 anxiety and lets managers focus on onboarding content rather than admin. Keep this friction-light and iterate from measurable signals.
